span.boundary_evidence: ReadParam starts at 0x40f790 after InstallRDrivers. The SetDateTime branch ends at 0x40f7dc, where Delay begins.

changes: Extracted ReadParam through SetDateTime from SysUtil.a. Preserved the original author, copyright, applicable history, and routine comments.
Removed the later WriteParam A0/A1 save and restore. The ROM has neither instruction. The source history records a read-back verification change in July 1990.
Removed the later Trap suffixes. Added low-memory equates from the original interface files and target addresses for the four clock calls. Branches retain the word widths found in the ROM.
Added a note correcting the original ReadDateTime description while retaining the original comment text. ReadDateTime calls ReadTime and copies the Time global to the caller's buffer.

limitations: The four clock call targets are established by their encoded ROM displacements. This excerpt does not reconstruct the target procedures.
Byte equality verifies the complete span. Exact historical source spelling and file boundaries remain inferred.
